rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=200, val_chunk=5, train_n=400, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=10, tv_step_init=0.001, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_share_steps=False, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=l1, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-5 (breast_ct). LOSS-FORMULATION probe. iters 1-4 mapped step (1e-2 diverge, 1e-4/1e-3 collapse-to-FBP) and depth (K=50 also collapses) -- under MSE the optimiser ALWAYS drives step[k]->0 and sits on the FBP init (psnr~36.3=baseline, hr0, loss floor ~0.00624 = FBP's own MSE). NAMED failure: FBP-init is an MSE-optimal attractor -- TV smoothing trades pixel-MSE for perceptual quality, so a pixel-MSE loss has NO incentive to move off FBP. HYPOTHESIS: an L1 loss weights outliers (the sparse-view streak/noise residual in FBP) differently from MSE and is NOT minimised by staying exactly at FBP -- so the optimiser keeps step non-zero and does real streak/noise removal, moving val metrics off the FBP floor and clearing hr>0. ONE KNOB: loss_base mse -> l1 (K=10, step_init=1e-3, lambda_init=1e-3 kept from iter-3; K reverted 50->10 to isolate the loss knob and fit budget). All else identical. FALSIFIER: if L1 also collapses step->0 and hr stays 0, the FBP-init attractor is loss-agnostic on dense-view breast -> the supervised-unrolled-TV skeleton cannot beat FBP here regardless of loss (matches findings 2026-05-23) and I pivot to lambda/architecture knobs. BUDGET: K=10 -> ~750s like iter-3, well under 1200s wall.
